summary: Qiwen Xiao is a scholar in Buddhist studies. Xiao earned a Master of Arts at Fo Guang University, where the degree was supervised by Yongdong Shi (attested 2013).

R. Balasubramanian (1929–2017) was an Indian philosopher and Indologist who studied under the traditional teacher Varahur Kalyanasundara Sastri. He served as Director at the University of Madras from circa 1976 to 1990.

R. Gordon Wasson (1898–1986) worked in Indology and religious studies. He studied at Columbia University and the London School of Economics, and held posts in journalism, the American Expeditionary Forces, Guaranty Trust Company, and J.P. Morgan & Co.
R. N. Gadre was an Indologist. In 1959, he was attested as Professor of Sanskrit at both Sir Parashurambhau College and Savitribai Phule Pune University.
R. P. Paranjpye (1876–1966) was a student of Vaman Shivram Apte. He served as Vice-Chancellor of Savitribai Phule Pune University (attested 1959).

R. Thangaswami Sarma (1924–2000) studied at The Madras Sanskrit College and Annamalai University. An Indologist and philosopher, he held posts at Presidency College, the University of Madras, Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, ICPR, and Adyar Library and Research Centre.

R. Venkatraman completed a PhD at Madurai Kamaraj University (1975–1980) under doctoral supervisors N. Subrahmanian and N. Jagadeesan. Specializing in history, archaeology, and religious studies, he was attested as a Reader at Madurai Kamaraj University in 1990.
Rachael Wiseman is a philosopher who studied at the University of York from circa 2005 to 2009. She held a post at the University of Liverpool around 2013.

Rachel H. Pang works in Tibetology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Virginia and was attested in 2019 as the Lester D. Coltrane III Assistant Professor of Religious Studies at Davidson College.

Rachelle M. Scott is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. She completed her dissertation at Northwestern University under George D. Bond and Robert Launay, and held a post at the University of Tennessee (attested 2009–2017).

Radhika Herzberger is a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Toronto (circa 1975–1982) under Bimal Krishna Matilal, and served as Director of Studies at Rishi Valley School (~1982–2012).

Rafal Stepien, a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy, completed his PhD at Columbia University under Chun-fang Yu and Bernard Faure. He was an Academic Visitor at Wadham College (2012–2013) and an Exchange Scholar at Harvard University (2015).

Rafał Jan Felbur is a scholar in Buddhist studies and sinology. He studied at Stanford University as a PhD candidate under doctoral supervisor Paul Harrison, as well as teachers John R. McRae and Luis Oscar Gómez.

Raffaele Torella is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied under Raniero Gnoli. He has served as a faculty member at Sapienza University of Rome and as a professor at the University of Naples "L'Orientale".
Raffaello Orlando is a scholar in sinology and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at Princeton University in 1981 under the supervision of Denis Twitchett.

Raghu Ananthanarayanan studied engineering at IIT Madras and trained under Tirumalai Krishnamacharya and T. K. V. Desikachar. Active in philosophy, he taught at Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram and was a visiting faculty member at IIM Ahmedabad (attested 2010).

Raghu Vira (1902–1963) was a scholar of Indology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and Tibetology. He studied at the University of the Punjab (~1920–1924) and Leiden University (~1928–1930), and taught Lokesh Chandra.

Raghunath Damodar Karmarkar (1893–1964) was an Indology and philosophy scholar who taught Jikido Takasaki. He served as Principal of Sir Parashurambhau College and held posts including Professor and Director of the Post-Graduate and Research Department at BORI.
Raghunath Giri was a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya and taught Atsushi Uno. He served as a department head (科長) at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith.

Rahul Peter Das is a scholar of Indology and linguistics who studied at Calcutta, Cologne, and Hamburg. He held research and teaching posts at Hamburg, Bonn, Groningen, and Marburg, and took a chair at Halle-Wittenberg in 1994.
